name: PrintSage
summary: US print on demand from ShipSage: custom apparel printed in-house in six US fulfillment centers and shipped in about two days, with a Shopify app and connections to Etsy, TikTok Shop and Amazon. No subscription and no minimum order.
best_for: Shopify, Etsy, TikTok Shop and Amazon sellers who sell custom apparel mainly to US customers and want in-house US printing with 2-day delivery and no subscription
skip_if: most of your customers are outside the US, or you want a wide product range beyond apparel, such as wall art, phone cases or photo books
honest_knock: There is no published price list beyond the per-product 'from' prices in the catalogue, so you only see your real cost per item, including shipping, when you build an order. Production and shipping are US-only: six US fulfillment centers, no overseas production, so it is built for selling to US customers. Printing is DTF by default; DTG for a softer print on 100% cotton needs a conversation with their team. The range is mostly apparel, with mugs, tote bags and some accessories.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-02 on printsage.com and on ShipSage's print-on-demand page, shipsage.com/print-on-demand; prices in US dollars) PrintSage has no subscription and no plan price. It is free to install, there is no setup fee and no minimum order, and you pay only when an order ships: production and shipping are itemized per order and billed through Stripe. The catalogue on printsage.com showed blanks from $2.50 (a BasePrint 180g cotton tee) up to $11.42 (a Hanes EcoSmart crewneck sweatshirt), with branded blanks such as the Gildan 5000 tee from $6.45 and the BELLA + CANVAS 3001 from $8.15; product cards showed shipping from $4.50. ShipSage's earnings calculator uses a fulfillment cost of $5.49 per item as its example and notes that shipping, taxes and platform fees are not included. For larger volumes ShipSage says the per-unit cost drops and quotes are given through its sales team; we did not see a published volume price list.

compare_with.name: Printify
compare_with.why: Printify is a print network: it routes orders to third-party print providers around the world, with a free plan and a paid Premium plan that lowers product prices. PrintSage prints in-house in its own US warehouses with no plan at all; compare the landed cost of the same blank, including shipping, for your customers' locations
